The primary subject is a male (blackcock) standing in profile, exhibiting glossy black plumage with iridescent sheens, prominent red eyebrow combs, and white wing bars. A secondary subject, a female (greyhen), sits in the foreground, displaying mottled brown camouflage plumage and smaller red combs. The lighting suggests late afternoon or early morning sun.
